{"consolidated_memory":"**Duplicate Charge Issue in billing/webhooks/stripe.py — Four Separate Incidents**

**Common Pattern Across All Four Occasions:**
- Component: billing/webhooks/stripe.py (billing side)
- Problem: Duplicate charge in webhook consumer
- Signal: Two ledger rows sharing one event id
- Repro method: Redeliver the same webhook id twice
- Test file: tests/billing/test_stripe_webhook.py

---

**Occasion 1: [2026-06-22] — Unicode Normalisation Missing**
- Trigger: Problem appeared only when input list came in empty
- Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest (PR #3139, branch fix/duplicate-charge-1)
- Result: Flaky test improved from 50 failures per hundred runs to zero

**Occasion 2: [2026-06-26] — Missing Composite Index**
- Trigger: Problem appeared only for users sitting in negative UTC offset
- Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: Added composite index and backfilled in batches (PR #5620, branch fix/duplicate-charge-2)
- Result: Backlog cleared 36 minutes after deploy

**Occasion 3: [2026-08-02] — Serialiser Dropping Unknown Fields**
- Trigger: Problem appeared only for traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- Root cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: Switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields (PR #8283, branch fix/duplicate-charge-3)
- Result: Error rate dropped from 1.2 percent to under 8 per ten thousand

**Occasion 4: [2026-08-14] — Config Loader Reading Wrong Environment File**
- Trigger: Problem appeared only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #9802, branch fix/duplicate-charge-4)
- Result: Job finished in 3 minutes instead of 2 hours"}
